question: Where can I get a list of stand-alone battery storage (BESS) projects currently in permitting in the United States, with location, power (MW), developer, permitting stage and date?

answer.summary: US stand-alone BESS permitting is split across state and local authorities; no complete national list was found in the inherited research. EIA-860M September 2026 (released October) gives a planned-generator proxy with 34 filtered stand-alone cases >=1 MW, coordinates and Entity Name, but lacks permit stages/dates and misses early or local applications. Sampled state portals provide actual stages and dates in CA, WA and MA; linked dockets and PDFs supply further details. Paid trackers have different coverage.
main_caveats: Cross-checking Sep 2026 EIA-860M (L) proves it misses active state siting cases: 4/5 CA CEC Opt-In BESS under review, WA Goldeneye (200 MW), and MA EFSB 26-01/26-02 do not appear in EIA-860M (L).

EIA-860 annual 3_4_Energy_Storage 'Independent' column is blank in 89/90 Status='L' rows and labels hybrid Plant 65043 ('Dulles Solar and Storage') as 'Y'; stand-alone BESS must be derived across Plant IDs.
Grid interconnection queues (NYISO, ERCOT GIS, CAISO, LBNL Queued Up, Interconnection.fyi) track transmission study status and target COD, NOT siting or environmental permitting.
Texas leads EIA-860M stand-alone (L) with 16 of 34 plants nationwide despite having no state BESS siting board, underscoring that most BESS permit locally at county/municipal level.
Open non-official portals freeze in Jan 2022 (Sandia GESDB), lack a BESS tracker (GEM), have ~0 proposed BESS (OSM Taginfo), or mirror EIA-860M (US Energy Map); PUC+EIA trackers (Halcyon) are paid.
answer.confidence_reason: Verified directly against Sep 2026 EIA-860M/2025 EIA-860 spreadsheets, federal NEPA/FAST-41 portals, 9 state siting portals, NYISO queue workbook, OSM Taginfo, Sandia GESDB, GEM, and commercial trackers.

attributes.gap_note: The original stage and project-list rows document absent national tracking of local zoning, environmental and other siting sub-stages.

unit.value: Individual electric generating or storage unit row (`Planned` tab); aggregate/filter across `Operating` and `Planned` by `Plant ID` to separate stand-alone BESS (`Batteries` only) from co-located hybrids.
unit.quote: monitors the current status of existing and proposed generating units at electric power plants with 1 megawatt or greater of combined nameplate capacity.

inclusion_rule.value: Electric power plants >=1 MW combined nameplate capacity expected in commercial operation within 5 years (for non-coal/non-nuclear generators), mandatory under FEAA Section 13(b). Status '(L) Regulatory approvals pending. Not under construction' flags units awaiting regulatory approvals.
inclusion_rule.quote: Complete this Schedule for all generators at this plant that are: ... Expected to be in commercial operation within 5 years for all generators other than coal and nuclear generators.

reference_date.value: September 2026 inventory edition (released October 23, 2026; HTTP Last-Modified: Fri, 23 Oct 2026 15:32:18 GMT).
reference_date.quote: Release Date: October 23, 2026 Next Release Date: November 24, 2026

update_frequency.value: Monthly for EIA-860M (monthly changing `<month>_generator<year>.xlsx` URL); annual for EIA-860 (`Final 2025 data` released Sep 10, 2026).
update_frequency.quote: The monthly survey Form EIA-860M, Monthly Update to Annual Electric Generator Report supplements the annual survey form EIA-860 data with monthly information

exclusions.value: Excludes installations <1 MW, behind-the-meter/unreported sites, projects >5 years out, permitting stage details, permit filing/approval dates, `Planned` MWh energy capacity, and early state/local permitting projects not yet reported to EIA (verified missing: 4/5 CA CEC Opt-In BESS, WA Goldeneye, MA EFSB 26-01/26-02).
exclusions.quote: L | Regulatory approvals pending. Not under construction but site preparation could be underway

key_fields.meaning: Unique EIA plant identifier used to check whether non-battery technologies share the site across Operating and Planned sheets
Project entity / SPV LLC / utility name
'Batteries' (coupled with Energy Source Code='MWH', Prime Mover Code='BA')
'(L) Regulatory approvals pending. Not under construction' (coarse permitting-phase status)
State, county, and site WGS84 coordinates (0 missing in Sep 2026 Status (L) rows)
Target commercial operation date (NOT permit application or approval date)

how_to_use.example_request: curl -sS -L -o /tmp/eia860m.xlsx "https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx" && python3 -c "import zipfile, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET; print([s.attrib['name'] for s in ET.fromstring(zipfile.ZipFile('/tmp/eia860m.xlsx').read('xl/workbook.xml')).iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}sheet')])"
how_to_use.example_result: sheets: ['Operating', 'Planned', 'Retired', 'Canceled or Postponed', ...]; Planned valid=2358 -> Batteries=483 -> Status '(L)'=85 -> Stand-alone=34 (Sample: Entity 65764 'Lighthouse Pier S, LLC', Plant 66787 'Elevate Pier S', CA, Los Angeles, 70 MW, 12/2026, 33.764993, -118.223700).
steps: Fetch https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/ to locate the latest <month>_generator<year>.xlsx file URL.
Parse header row 3 (`Plant ID` on 0-indexed row 2) of `Operating` and `Planned` tabs, dropping trailing `NOTES` rows without numeric `Plant ID`.

Build set of `Plant ID`s with any generator `Technology != 'Batteries'` in `Operating` or `Planned`, then filter `Planned` for `Technology == 'Batteries'`, `Status` starting with `'(L)'`, and `Plant ID` not in non-battery set.
reading_traps: Annual EIA-860 `3_4_Energy_Storage_Y2025.xlsx` (`Proposed`) contains an `Independent` column that is blank in 89/90 Status='L' rows and set to `'Y'` only on hybrid Plant `65043` ('Dulles Solar and Storage'), which also has Solar PV — do NOT rely on `Independent` to identify stand-alone BESS.
Header row is on Excel row 3 (rows 1-2 are titles) and footer `NOTES` lines appear at the bottom of each sheet.
EIA Open Data API v2 (`https://api.eia.gov/v2/electricity/`) requires API key registration (`API_KEY_MISSING` HTTP 403) and exposes operating capability/generation rather than planned `(L)` filings.
`Planned` tab reports MW power capacity only, not MWh energy capacity.

problems: Lacks permitting sub-stages and permitting/filing dates; misses early state-permitting BESS (4/5 CA CEC Opt-In, WA Goldeneye, MA EFSB 26-01/26-02).

open_questions: Audit the remaining ~40 US states (notably TX county/fire-marshal processes, plus AZ, NV, IL, IN, CO, NM, ME, VT) and a sample of county planning portals to quantify local-only BESS visibility outside EIA-860M.

Re-test WAF/geo-blocked state siting portals from a US IP or browser session: VA DEQ Renewable Energy PBR (403 + MapServer/280 404), MI MPSC PA 233 (403), MN PUC Energy Storage (Radware Captcha), TX PUC (403), and MA EFSB CloudFront petition PDFs (403 country block).
Evaluate Halcyon BESS Tracker under a trial/subscription to quantify how completely PUC dockets capture stand-alone BESS vs county-only projects.

history.note: No national BESS permitting registry exists; EIA-860M Status (L) lists 34 stand-alone projects without permit stages/dates, while sampled state siting portals cover subsets with real stages/dates.

local_terms.term: Stand-alone BESS / Front-of-the-Meter (FTM) Energy Storage System
local_terms.meaning: Battery facility not co-located with generation; isolated in EIA-860M by checking that all units sharing Plant ID across Operating + Planned have Technology='Batteries'.

local_terms.term: Status (L) — Regulatory approvals pending. Not under construction
local_terms.meaning: Form EIA-860/860M planned generator status code indicating approvals/permits are pending prior to construction.

local_terms.term: Opt-In Certification (CA AB 205 / Pub. Resources Code § 25545)
local_terms.meaning: California Energy Commission optional statewide CEQA/siting certification pathway for >=200 MWh energy storage systems, alternative to county conditional use permits.

local_terms.term: Site Certification / CPCN / Certificate of Environmental Impact and Public Interest
local_terms.meaning: State siting permit terms used by WA EFSEC, CT CSC, and MA EFSB for state-jurisdiction projects.

local_terms.term: Conditional Use Permit (CUP) / Special Use Permit (SUP)
local_terms.meaning: County or municipal land-use zoning permit required in states without a state BESS siting board (e.g. Texas) or below state capacity thresholds.
Model U.S. fire safety codes governing stationary BESS fire permitting, hazard mitigation analysis, and UL 9540A testing.
